module.source: Sunova SS-550-72MDH mono PERC datasheet (Pmax temp. coeff. -0.35 %/degC, NOCT 45+/-2 degC, 2279 x 1134 x 35 mm), https://download.axilogi.com/Sunova/SS-535-550-72MDH.pdf, accessed 2026-11-01

losses.source: l_other: NREL PVWatts v5 default losses (Dobos 2014, NREL/TP-6A20-62641; same defaults in pvlib pvwatts_losses) without shading: soiling 2%, mismatch 2%, wiring 2%, connections 0.5%, LID 1.5%, nameplate 1%, availability 3% (combined 11.4%), times 96% nominal inverter efficiency (PVWatts default) = 15.0%. Temperature excluded (handled by gamma).

forecast.source: rain_min_mm: IMD 'rainy day' definition (24-hour rainfall of 2.5 mm or more). Ratios (day plane-of-array sunlight vs a typical day of that month from the 10-year climatology): Aroha design choice, display labels only, never used in estimates.
